;
; type Color = Red | Green | Blue
; type MaybeN = NoN | SomeN(Nat)
; type Flag = Off | On(Bool)
; type Lst = LNil | LCons(Nat, Lst)
; type Hold = Empty | Held(Lst)
; type Tr = TLeaf(Nat) | TMid | TNode(Tr, Tr)
;
; fn mk(n: Nat) -> Tr {
;     TNode(TLeaf(n), TMid())
; }
;
; #[partial]
; fn pick(c: Color, n: Nat) -> Color {
;     match c {
;         Red() => if n == 0 { Red() } else { pick(Green(), n - 1) },
;         Green() => Blue(),
;         Blue() => Red(),
;     }
; }
;
; fn find(l: Lst, k: Nat) -> MaybeN {
;     match l {
;         LNil() => NoN(),
;         LCons(x, rest) => if x == k { SomeN(x) } else { find(rest, k) },
;     }
; }
;
; #[partial]
; fn flip(f: Flag, n: Nat) -> Flag {
;     match f {
;         Off() => if n == 0 { Off() } else { flip(On(true), n - 1) },
;         On(b) => if n == 0 { On(b) } else { flip(Off(), n - 1) },
;     }
; }
;
; fn main() -> Nat {
;     let l = LCons(1, LCons(2, LNil()));
;     let r = find(l, 2);
;     let c = pick(Red(), 3);
;     let f = flip(Off(), 4);
;     let h = Held(l);
;     let t = mk(1);
;     match r {
;         NoN() => 0,
;         SomeN(v) => v,
;     }
; }
;

  br label %merge15

  %mu_alloc.arena = call ptr @__albite_alloc(i64 20, i32 0)
  br label %alloc.join

alloc.join:                                       ; preds = %alloc.arena, %alloc.malloc
  %mu_alloc = phi ptr [ %mu_alloc.malloc, %alloc.malloc ], [ %mu_alloc.arena, %alloc.arena ]
  store { i32, [16 x i8] } %sum_val, ptr %mu_alloc, align 16
  %pair_snd = insertvalue { i64, ptr } { i64 2, ptr null }, ptr %mu_alloc, 1
  %sum_alloca1 = alloca { i32, [16 x i8] }, align 16
  %tag_ptr2 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [16 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca1, i32 0, i32 0
  store i32 1, ptr %tag_ptr2, align 4
  %data_ptr3 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [16 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca1, i32 0, i32 1
  store { i64, ptr } %pair_snd, ptr %data_ptr3, align 4
  %sum_val4 = load { i32, [16 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca1, align 16
  %arena.mode5 = load i32, ptr @__albite_arena_mode, align 4
  %arena.off6 = icmp eq i32 %arena.mode5, 0
  br i1 %arena.off6, label %alloc.malloc7, label %alloc.arena8, !prof !0

alloc.malloc7:                                    ; preds = %alloc.join
  %mu_alloc.malloc10 = call ptr @malloc(i64 20)
  br label %alloc.join9

alloc.arena8:                                     ; preds = %alloc.join
  %mu_alloc.arena11 = call ptr @__albite_alloc(i64 20, i32 0)
  br label %alloc.join9

alloc.join9:                                      ; preds = %alloc.arena8, %alloc.malloc7
  %mu_alloc12 = phi ptr [ %mu_alloc.malloc10, %alloc.malloc7 ], [ %mu_alloc.arena11, %alloc.arena8 ]
  store { i32, [16 x i8] } %sum_val4, ptr %mu_alloc12, align 16
  %pair_snd13 = insertvalue { i64, ptr } { i64 1, ptr null }, ptr %mu_alloc12, 1
  %sum_alloca14 = alloca { i32, [16 x i8] }, align 16
  %tag_ptr15 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [16 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca14, i32 0, i32 0
  store i32 1, ptr %tag_ptr15, align 4
  %data_ptr16 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [16 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca14, i32 0, i32 1
  store { i64, ptr } %pair_snd13, ptr %data_ptr16, align 4
  %sum_val17 = load { i32, [16 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca14, align 16
  %arena.mode18 = load i32, ptr @__albite_arena_mode, align 4
  %arena.off19 = icmp eq i32 %arena.mode18, 0
  br i1 %arena.off19, label %alloc.malloc20, label %alloc.arena21, !prof !0

alloc.malloc20:                                   ; preds = %alloc.join9
  %mu_alloc.malloc23 = call ptr @malloc(i64 20)
  br label %alloc.join22

alloc.arena21:                                    ; preds = %alloc.join9
  %mu_alloc.arena24 = call ptr @__albite_alloc(i64 20, i32 0)
  br label %alloc.join22

alloc.join22:                                     ; preds = %alloc.arena21, %alloc.malloc20
  %mu_alloc25 = phi ptr [ %mu_alloc.malloc23, %alloc.malloc20 ], [ %mu_alloc.arena24, %alloc.arena21 ]
  store { i32, [16 x i8] } %sum_val17, ptr %mu_alloc25, align 16
  %direct_call = call { i32, [8 x i8] } @"find$direct"(ptr null, ptr %mu_alloc25, i64 2)
  %adt_alloca = alloca { i32, [0 x i8] }, align 16
  %tag_ptr26 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [0 x i8] }, ptr %adt_alloca, i32 0, i32 0
  store i32 0, ptr %tag_ptr26, align 4
  %data_ptr27 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [0 x i8] }, ptr %adt_alloca, i32 0, i32 1
  store {} zeroinitializer, ptr %data_ptr27, align 4
  %adt_val = load { i32, [0 x i8] }, ptr %adt_alloca, align 16
  %direct_call28 = call { i32, [0 x i8] } @"pick$direct"(ptr null, { i32, [0 x i8] } %adt_val, i64 3)
  %sum_alloca29 = alloca { i32, [1 x i8] }, align 16
  %tag_ptr30 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [1 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca29, i32 0, i32 0
  store i32 0, ptr %tag_ptr30, align 4
  %data_ptr31 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [1 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca29, i32 0, i32 1
  store {} zeroinitializer, ptr %data_ptr31, align 4
  %sum_val32 = load { i32, [1 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca29, align 16
  %direct_call33 = call { i32, [1 x i8] } @"flip$direct"(ptr null, { i32, [1 x i8] } %sum_val32, i64 4)
  %sum_alloca34 = alloca { i32, [8 x i8] }, align 16
  %tag_ptr35 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [8 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca34, i32 0, i32 0
  store i32 1, ptr %tag_ptr35, align 4
  %data_ptr36 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [8 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca34, i32 0, i32 1
  store ptr %mu_alloc25, ptr %data_ptr36, align 4
  %sum_val37 = load { i32, [8 x i8] }, ptr %sum_alloca34, align 16
  %call = call ptr @mk(ptr null, i64 1)
  %case_sum_ptr = alloca { i32, [8 x i8] }, align 16
  store { i32, [8 x i8] } %direct_call, ptr %case_sum_ptr, align 16
  %tag_ptr38 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [8 x i8] }, ptr %case_sum_ptr, i32 0, i32 0
  %tag = load i32, ptr %tag_ptr38, align 4
  %data_ptr39 = getelementptr inbounds { i32, [8 x i8] }, ptr %case_sum_ptr, i32 0, i32 1
  %is_left = icmp eq i32 %tag, 0
  br i1 %is_left, label %case_left, label %case_right

case_left:                                        ; preds = %alloc.join22
  %__ctor_NoN_payload = load {}, ptr %data_ptr39, align 4
  br label %case_merge

case_right:                                       ; preds = %alloc.join22
  %__rest0_payload = load i64, ptr %data_ptr39, align 4
  br label %case_merge

case_merge:                                       ; preds = %case_right, %case_left
  %case_result = phi i64 [ 0, %case_left ], [ %__rest0_payload, %case_right ]
  ret i64 %case_result
}

declare { ptr, ptr } @find(ptr, ptr)

declare { i32, [8 x i8] } @"find$direct"(ptr, ptr, i64)

declare void @"find$direct_mt"(ptr noalias nonnull sret({ i32, [8 x i8] }) align 4 dereferenceable(12), ptr, ptr, i64)

declare { ptr, ptr } @flip(ptr, { i32, [1 x i8] })

declare { i32, [1 x i8] } @"flip$direct"(ptr, { i32, [1 x i8] }, i64)

declare void @"flip$direct_mt"(ptr noalias nonnull sret({ i32, [1 x i8] }) align 4 dereferenceable(8), ptr noalias nonnull align 4 dereferenceable(8), ptr, i64)

declare ptr @mk(ptr, i64)

declare { ptr, ptr } @pick(ptr, { i32, [0 x i8] })

declare { i32, [0 x i8] } @"pick$direct"(ptr, { i32, [0 x i8] }, i64)

declare void @"pick$direct_mt"(ptr noalias nonnull sret({ i32, [0 x i8] }) align 4 dereferenceable(4), ptr noalias nonnull align 4 dereferenceable(4), ptr, i64)

define i32 @__albite_inner_main() {
entry:
  call void @__albite_install_signal_handlers()
  call void @__albite_arena_init()
  %argc = load i32, ptr @__albite_argc, align 4
  %argv = load ptr, ptr @__albite_argv, align 8
  call void @tg_init_args_c(i32 %argc, ptr %argv)
  %main_result = call i64 @albite_main(ptr null)
  %0 = call i32 (ptr, ...) @printf(ptr @nat_fmt, i64 %main_result)
  ret i32 0
}

declare void @__albite_install_signal_handlers()

declare void @tg_init_args_c(i32, ptr)

define i32 @main(i32 %0, ptr %1) {
entry:
  store i32 %0, ptr @__albite_argc, align 4
  store ptr %1, ptr @__albite_argv, align 8
  %exit_code = call i32 @__albite_inner_main()
  ret i32 %exit_code
}

!0 = !{!"branch_weights", i32 2000, i32 1}
